_comment: caelestia4: options Nexus leaves out on purpose, {id or glob: reason}. tools/nexus-coverage.py reads it (fnmatch globs, * matches dots too).
_not_ignored: e4:background.workspacePresets is a user toggle (Wallpaper & style > Presets, PresetSelect.qml), not shell state: it gets a registry row (RegAppearance), so it is not listed here.
c:appearance.font.mono.large.*: Nothing reads Tokens.font.mono.large: no QML under dots/.config/quickshell/ii uses it (only mono.medium, mono.small)
c:background.desktopClock.enabled: Written by the x:desktop.clock style chooser on appearance/desktop (DesktopPage.qml:170 sets it when the Caelestia style is picked); a second toggle would fight it
c:background.visualiser.enabled: Written by the x:desktop.visualiser style chooser on appearance/desktop (DesktopPage.qml:181 sets it when the Caelestia style is picked)
c:enabled: Nothing reads ConfigRoot.enabled (plugin Config/rootnodes.hpp:31): no QML or plugin code in caelestia4 checks it
c:general.apps.audio: Nothing reads it; only apps.playback and apps.explorer are read (utilities/cards/RecordingList.qml:112,122). AppsPage.qml:61 already says so
c:general.apps.terminal: No shell code reads it. Apps > Terminal (AppsPage.qml:57) writes it along with xdg-terminals.list, and uwsm and xdg-terminal-exec use that file
c:general.idle.*: Caelestia's idle monitors are not ported, so nothing reads general.idle. Idle runs through hypridle with e4:caelestia.idle.* (lockMinutes, screenOffMinutes, suspendMinutes, lockBeforeSleep; RegPower.qml, scripts/caelestia4/hypridle-timeouts.sh)
c:lock.*: Read only by Caelestia's own lock screen, which caelestia4 does not port: panelFamilies/CaelestiaFamily.qml:48 loads end-4's modules/ii/lock (configured by e4:lock.*)
c:paths.lockNoNotifsPic: Read only by Caelestia's lock screen (plugin Config/userpaths.hpp:23, no QML reader), which caelestia4 does not load: CaelestiaFamily.qml:48 uses end-4's modules/ii/lock
e4:appearance.fakeScreenRounding: No reader anywhere under dots/.config/quickshell/ii or dots/.config/hypr (end-4's screen-corner panel is gone). Caelestia's border (c:border.rounding) draws the screen corners
e4:appearance.fonts.iconNerd: Only Appearance.qml:249 maps it to Appearance.font.family.iconNerd, and nothing in caelestia4 reads Appearance.font.family.iconNerd (the end-4 bar that used it is gone)
e4:appearance.fonts.monospace: Mirrors c:appearance.font.mono.family; FontsPage.qml:59 (MirrorWatch) already copies the Caelestia value into it. Synced from c:appearance.font.mono.family (ServiceLoader)
e4:appearance.transparency.enable: Mirrors c:appearance.transparency.enabled; WallpaperAndStyle.qml:224 (MirrorWatch) already copies it. Synced from c:appearance.transparency.enabled (ServiceLoader)
e4:appearance.wallpaperTheming.terminalG: Read only on switchwall.sh's matugen path, which caelestia4 never reaches (the caelestia-cli branch returns first; scheme.py doesn't read it)
e4:apps.bluetooth: No reader in caelestia4. Only end-4's right sidebar (not loaded) launched this app. Caelestia's bar popouts open Nexus instead
e4:apps.changePassword: Only Session.changePassword() reads it (modules/common/functions/Session.qml:16), and nothing in caelestia4 calls that function
e4:apps.manageUser: No reader anywhere in caelestia4. It was used only by end-4's right sidebar, which is not loaded
e4:apps.network: No reader in caelestia4. Only end-4's right sidebar quick toggles (not loaded) launched it. The Caelestia network popout opens Nexus
e4:apps.networkEthernet: No reader in caelestia4. It was used only by end-4's right sidebar, which is not loaded
e4:apps.terminal: No reader. caelestia4 uses ~/.config/xdg-terminals.list and c:general.apps.terminal (pages/AppsPage.qml:57)
e4:apps.update: No reader. Updates run through modules/caelestia/adapters/SystemUpdates.qml and scripts/caelestia4/system-update.sh, not this command
e4:apps.volumeMixer: No reader. Only end-4's sidebar launched it. caelestia4 has the Caelestia audio popout and Nexus > Audio > App volumes
e4:background.hideWhenFullscreen: Read only by end-4's own background (modules/ii/background in upstream); caelestia4's modules/caelestia/background/Background.qml and PcWidgetsLoader.qml never read it, nothing under dots/ or scripts/ does
e4:background.lockWall: Lock screen wallpaper of the applied preset: written by preset import
e4:background.parallax.autoVertical: Nothing in caelestia4 reads it: modules/caelestia/background/Background.qml:65 reads only parallax.vertical, enableWorkspace, workspaceZoom, widgetsFactor
e4:background.parallax.enableSidebar: end-4's sidebar-open parallax; caelestia4's Background.qml (parallax block at :63-66) never reads it and no other file does
e4:background.thumbnailPath: Current wallpaper's thumbnail: written by the wallpaper switcher
e4:background.wallpaperPath: Current wallpaper: written by the wallpaper switcher
e4:background.widgets.*.x: Widget position: written when the widget is dragged on the desktop
e4:background.widgets.*.y: Widget position: written when the widget is dragged on the desktop
e4:background.widgets.*.z: Widget stacking order: written when a widget is raised on the desktop
e4:background.widgets.canvas.*: Size of the screen the widgets were placed on: written by the shell and by preset import
e4:background.widgets.clock.cookie.dateI: Declared in Config.qml:234 but nothing under modules/caelestia/background/pcwidgets/clock (or anywhere else) reads it; only E4Defaults.js lists it
e4:background.widgets.clock.showOnlyWhen: Read by pcwidgets/clock/ClockWidget.qml for the lock screen. Not in Nexus yet: the lock screen is being reworked and its look options will change
e4:background.widgets.clock.styleLocked: Read by pcwidgets/clock/ClockWidget.qml while locked; Nexus widgets/ClockWidgetPage.qml setDesktopClock() writes it with clock.style. Not a row of its own while the lock screen is being reworked
e4:background.widgets.glass.enable: Liquid glass is not ported (Config.qml:210, WidgetCard.qml:15): no glass shader exists; only WorldClockWidget.qml:304 peeks at it to drop its blur, so turning it on would only break the world clock card
e4:background.widgets.media.backgroundSh: Declared in Config.qml:284 but MediaWidget.qml never reads it (grep for backgroundShape in modules/ and services/ finds only Config.qml)
e4:background.widgets.media.showControls: Declared in Config.qml:281 but MediaWidget.qml never reads it; controls are always shown
e4:background.widgets.media.showLyrics: MediaWidget.qml:86 keeps its own local showLyrics (toggled by its button, :671) and never reads the config key
e4:background.widgets.media.showTitles: Declared in Config.qml:283 but MediaWidget.qml never reads it
e4:background.widgets.weather.expanded: Declared in Config.qml:269 but WeatherWidget.qml never reads it (no 'expanded' in modules/caelestia/background/pcwidgets/weather)
e4:bar.autoHide.*: Read only by end-4's own bar (modules/ii/bar, removed). No reader in caelestia4; the Caelestia bar uses c:bar.persistent / c:bar.showOnHover
e4:bar.borderless: Read only by end-4's own bar (removed). Its only mention left is an example string in services/Ai.qml:108
e4:bar.bottom: Read only by end-4's own bar (removed). The Caelestia bar is always on the left edge of the frame
e4:bar.cornerStyle: Only feeds Appearance.sizes.barHeight/verticalBarWidth (Appearance.qml:418/438), which only end-4's removed bar used. No Caelestia consumer
e4:bar.floatStyleShadow: Read only by end-4's own bar (removed). No reader in caelestia4
e4:bar.indicators.notifications.showUnre: Read only by end-4's own bar (removed). No reader in caelestia4
e4:bar.media.preferredPlayer: Close to c:services.defaultPlayer, but not synced from it: only end-4's MprisController (services/MprisController.qml:22, used by the desktop media widget) reads it, while Caelestia's Players adapter uses c:services.defaultPlayer
e4:bar.resources.*: Read only by end-4's own bar resources module (removed). No reader in caelestia4
e4:bar.screenList: Read only by end-4's own bar (removed). The Caelestia bar uses c:bar.excludedScreens
e4:bar.showBackground: Read only by end-4's own bar (removed). No reader in caelestia4
e4:bar.tooltips.clickToShow: Read only by end-4's own bar (removed). No reader in caelestia4
e4:bar.topLeftIcon: Read only by end-4's own bar (removed). The Caelestia bar's OS icon uses c:general.logo
e4:bar.utilButtons.*: Read only by end-4's own bar utility buttons (removed). No reader in caelestia4
e4:bar.verbose: Only feeds Appearance.sizes.barCenterSideModuleWidth (Appearance.qml:420), which only end-4's removed bar used
e4:bar.vertical: Read only by end-4's own bar / vertical bar (removed). The Caelestia bar is always vertical
e4:bar.weather.city: Same meaning as c:services.weatherLocation. end-4's Weather service (services/Weather.qml:15, used by the desktop DailyClock and Weather widgets) and hypr/hyprlock/caelestia/weather.sh:8 read it. Synced from c:services.weatherLocation (ServiceLoader)
e4:bar.weather.enable: No reader. services/Weather.qml never checks it, and end-4's bar weather module that did is removed
e4:bar.weather.useUSCS: Same meaning as c:services.weatherUnits (Fahrenheit = true). Read by services/Weather.qml:16 and hyprlock weather.sh:9. Synced from c:services.weatherUnits (ServiceLoader)
e4:bar.workspaces.monochromeIcons: Read only by end-4's own bar workspaces (removed). No reader in caelestia4
e4:bar.workspaces.numberMap: Read only by end-4's own bar workspaces (removed). Caelestia uses c:bar.workspaces.workspaceIcons/label
e4:bar.workspaces.showAppIcons: Read only by end-4's own bar workspaces (removed). Caelestia uses c:bar.workspaces.showWindows
e4:bar.workspaces.shown: No end-4 reader. The Caelestia bar (Workspaces.qml:55) and the background (Background.qml:66) both read c:bar.workspaces.shown
e4:bar.workspaces.useNerdFont: Read only by end-4's own bar workspaces (removed). No reader in caelestia4
e4:calendar.locale: No reader. end-4's bar calendar popup is removed, and the Caelestia calendars use the app locale
e4:cheatsheet.fontSize.*: Read only by modules/ii/cheatsheet/CheatsheetKeybindsCategory.qml (:190, :216). caelestia4 loads modules/caelestia/cheatsheet, which imports only periodic_table.js from there
e4:conflictKiller.autoKillTrays: No effect: ConflictKiller only checks notification daemons (the kded6 tray check was removed in caelestia4), so the tray branch never runs
e4:interactions.deadPixelWorkaround.enab: No reader anywhere in caelestia4. Only end-4's removed bar/sidebar panels read it
e4:language.translator.engine: No reader. modules/caelestia/assistant/Translator.qml reads only the source/target languages and the delay, not the engine
e4:launcher.pinnedApps: No reader in caelestia4 (end-4's dock/launcher pins). The Caelestia launcher uses c:launcher.favouriteApps
e4:light.antiFlashbang.enable: Only read by end-4's services/Brightness.qml, which caelestia4 never creates (adapters/Brightness.qml replaces it); the Anti-flashbang toggle uses HyprlandAntiFlashbangShader
e4:lock.centerClock: Read by pcwidgets/clock/ClockWidget.qml while locked. Not in Nexus yet: the lock screen is being reworked and its look options will change
e4:lock.security.requirePasswordToPower: Read by modules/ii/lock/LockSurface.qml (its power buttons). Not in Nexus yet: the lock screen is being reworked
e4:lock.security.unlockKeyring: Read by modules/common/panels/lock/LockScreen.qml. Not in Nexus yet: the lock screen is being reworked, and with gnome-keyring's PAM module the keyring unlocks without it
e4:lock.showLockedText: Read by pcwidgets/clock/ClockWidget.qml while locked. Not in Nexus yet: the lock screen is being reworked and its look options will change
e4:lock.showWidgets: Read by pcwidgets/AbstractBackgroundWidget.qml (widgets on the lock screen). Not in Nexus yet: the lock screen is being reworked
e4:notifications.forceMonitor.*: No reader. end-4's notification popup (removed) used it. Caelestia notifications live in the Drawers frame
e4:notifications.timeout: Read only by services/Notifications.qml:177 (end-4's notification server), which no caelestia4 module uses. Caelestia notifications use c:notifs.defaultExpireTimeout
e4:osd.timeout: No reader. end-4's OSD is removed. The Caelestia OSD uses c:osd.hideDelay
e4:osk.layout: Internal state: services/HyprlandXkb.qml:112 writes it to follow the current keyboard layout (Osk.qml:32 reads it)
e4:overlay.floatingImage.scale: Internal state: FloatingImage.qml:55/58 writes it when the user scrolls on the image
e4:panelFamily: Unused: only the Caelestia panels exist (kept so old config files load)
e4:search.prefix.app: Has no effect: modules/caelestia/launcher/AppList.qml:34 skips end-4's app prefix (it clashes with c:launcher.actionPrefix), and Caelestia's own app search handles apps
e4:sidebar.booru.allowNsfw: Config key has no reader. The Anime tab uses Persistent.states.booru.allowNsfw (assistant/Anime.qml:103/143), which it writes itself
e4:sidebar.booru.defaultProvider: No reader. Booru.qml:363 uses Persistent.states.booru.provider (the last provider picked in the Anime tab)
e4:sidebar.cornerOpen.*: Read only by end-4's sidebar screen-corner hot zones (modules/ii sidebars, removed). No reader in caelestia4; Caelestia drawers open on hover via c:sidebar.showOnHover etc.
e4:sidebar.keepRightSidebarLoaded: Read only by end-4's right sidebar (removed). The Caelestia sidebar is a drawer in modules/caelestia/drawers
e4:sidebar.quickSliders.*: Read only by end-4's right sidebar (removed). Caelestia's Utilities Sliders card is used instead
e4:sidebar.quickToggles.*: Read only by end-4's right sidebar quick toggles (removed). Caelestia Utilities uses c:utilities.quickToggles
e4:time.dateWithYearFormat: Only feeds DateTime.date (DateTime.qml:23), whose one user is Weather.qml:83 lastRefresh, and nothing shows lastRefresh
e4:time.format: Mirrors c:services.clockFormat. ServiceLoader.qml:16 already writes it from Caelestia's 12/24-hour setting. Synced from c:services.clockFormat (ServiceLoader)
e4:time.shortDateFormat: Only feeds DateTime.shortDate (DateTime.qml:22), and nothing in caelestia4 reads DateTime.shortDate
e4:tray.filterPassive: No effect: the Caelestia tray (bar/components/Tray.qml shownInBar, bar/popouts/Content.qml) always hides passive items
e4:tray.monochromeIcons: No reader. end-4's bar tray (removed) used it. The Caelestia tray uses c:bar.tray.recolour
e4:tray.showItemId: Only read by TrayService.getTooltipForItem, which nothing calls
e4:waffles.*: Read only by modules/waffle/*, a panel family removed 2026-10-11 (shell.qml) that caelestia4 never loads. No reader left
e4:workSafety.enable.wallpaper: No reader: only Config.qml declares it. services/LauncherSearch.qml reads workSafety.enable.clipboard alone, and no wallpaper code checks work safety
e4:workSafety.triggerCondition.fileKeywo: No reader. services/LauncherSearch.qml checks only networkNameKeywords and linkKeywords (lines 131/138)
